item.title: Drake, AI & The Live Nation Case: Breaking Down Music’s Biggest Stories | Billboard On The Record
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host, Kristin Robinson: Welcome to Billboard On The Record. We're halfway through 2026, and the music industry has already had its fair share of headline-making moments. I'm joined today by Dan Rys, Elizabeth Dilts Marshall, and Bill Donahue to break down the biggest stories shaping the industry so far this year.
[Short music transition]
Kristin Robinson: From Spotify's AI remix plans to Drake's surprise three-album drop, it's been a wild ride. And let's not forget the company mergers and antitrust battles. Bill, what's the latest on Live Nation and Ticketmaster? Could they actually get broken up?
Bill Donahue: That's the big question. The judge has several options, including breaking up the company. However, it's historically very rare for this to happen.
Kristin Robinson: Dan, how do you think the independent music sector will be affected by all these developments?
Dan Rys: I don't think independent music companies should be worried. There's a lot of health in the sector, and we're seeing a blurring of the lines between independent and major labels.
Elizabeth Dilts Marshall: And let's not forget, music is still a relatively small player in the entertainment industry financially.
[Short music transition]
Kristin Robinson: We're also revisiting our predictions from the start of 2026. Which ones have come true, and what can we expect next? Tune in to find out. Don't forget to rate, review, and subscribe to Billboard On The Record, and follow us on social media @billboard.
[Outro music plays]
Kristin Robinson: Thanks for listening, and we'll catch you on the next episode of Billboard On The Record, a podcast in partnership with SickBird Productions.
